title: Capital Flows — dual digital credit engines
notes: Five columns: Income · Digital Credit · BTC · Liquidity Engine · Deploy · Digital Credit · Equities. Twin engines: Morpho (BTC) + RH margin (stocks). USDC HY / USDG HY = paired leverage governors (defense-only to collateral/book). Morpho→One Card = refinance. X Money→Agentic = 1st auto. Margin loan extract = optional, not income. No edge text labels on canvas.

edges.notes: Engine funnel (first-touch ACH still X Money on card).
Primary capitalization: income cash → BTC for Morpho collateral.
Refinance: Morpho new principal (~5%) → One Card (~29%). Raises LTV deliberately.
Park USDC as Morpho LTV buffer floor.
USDC→USDG parks as RH/Agentic margin buffer floor.
Control valve: HY → BTC collateral when Morpho LTV too high. Not the only income on-ramp.
Scheduled capital: X Money → RH Agentic auto transfer on the 1st of the month.
Agentic book holds / buys spot equities (unlevered layer of the stack).
Stocks collateralize RH margin loan — twin of BTC → Morpho.
Defense-only: USDG HY → Agentic book when RH margin heat too high; else buffer floor.
Optional defense path into equity collateral under margin heat.
Optional leverage extract to Liquidity Engine — NOT income. Dual-venue risk if Morpho USDC funded the margin.
Optional leverage extract back to CB engine — NOT income. Use sparingly.
